title: Network Engineer
description:
Monitor network connectivity and system performance. Assist in troubleshooting LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity-related issues . Support installation and configuration of switches, routers, access points, and other network devices . Handle basic network troubleshooting and resolve user connectivity issues. Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or the concerned team. Maintain network documentation, configurations, and troubleshooting records. Assist with preventive maintenance and routine network health checks. Follow IT security, access-control, and organizational procedures. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for network-related issues. Provide timely technical support and maintain proper service records

Key Skills: Network Operations,Network Support,LAN Troubleshooting,Network Infrastructure Management,Network Infrastructure,Network Monitoring,Network Management,Wireless Networking
